description: This file defines a decorator class for the HTMLPurifier cache system that performs cache cleanup operations when a cache miss occurs. It extends a base decorator class and overrides methods to add cleanup behavior after cache operations.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_DefinitionCache_Decorator_Cleanup
classes.description: A decorator class that wraps cache operations and performs cleanup on cache misses.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of the Cleanup decorator.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a definition to the cache, and triggers cleanup if the addition fails.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a definition in the cache, and triggers cleanup if the operation fails.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Replaces a definition in the cache, and triggers cleanup if the operation fails.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a definition from the cache, and triggers cleanup if the retrieval indicates a failure.
